evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as distinct categories of value — proportionality between what you keep and what you borrow, the asset/liability split of market-pricing.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Labels perspective as an 'asset you keep' — cost/benefit framing that distinguishes disposable commodity from retained value.
